stories.title: LeBron James Signs with 76ers — Embiid's Health Commitment Was the Key

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LeBron James didn't pick Philly for money.

He met with Joel Embiid privately for 2 hours.

Embiid said it was his first surgery-free summer ever. Felt completely healthy.

That answer is why LeBron is a 76er.

#SixersNation #NBA #LeBronJames

The 76ers went from 20-1 to 10-1 to win the title.

LeBron. Jaylen Brown. Joel Embiid.

Five MVPs. 32 All-Star selections. One city chasing its first championship since 1983.

#PhillyForever #NBA

LeBron James Signs with 76ers — Embiid's Health Commitment
**Sources:**
- Yahoo Sports: "LeBron James announces he's joining 76ers for his 24th NBA season: 'I still want to compete, to win'"
- Yahoo Sports: "LeBron James Got a Crucial Answer From Joel Embiid Before Sixers Move"

- Yahoo Sports (betting): "2026-27 NBA title odds: How LeBron James' surprising move to the Philadelphia 76ers shifted the market"
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LeBron James signed a 2-year, $8M contract with the Philadelphia 76ers, with a player option [NBA.com, Yahoo Sports]
- LeBron met with Joel Embiid in Los Angeles for nearly two hours approximately one month before the announcement [Heavy.com/Yahoo Sports]
- Embiid told LeBron he had completed his first surgery-free summer and felt "completely healthy" [Heavy.com]
- James is entering his 24th NBA season at age 41 [multiple sources]
- 76ers title odds shifted from 20-1 to 10-1 after the signing [Yahoo Sports]
- LeBron quote: "I still want to compete, to win and to have a chance at the feeling of winning another championship" [Yahoo Sports]
- LeBron quote: "I believe I can help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team and I am so excited to energize a new fan base and start this incredible journey one last time" [NBA.com]
- LeBron's agent Rich Paul confirmed the deal [ESPN/Yahoo Sports]
**Freshness justification:** Contract officially signed July 27 2026; Embiid health meeting details emerged day-of; title odds updated July 27.

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Investigation — Fact-Finding Phase Complete
**Sources:**
- Yahoo Sports: "Kawhi Leonard investigation reaches critical stage as NBA trade hangs in balance"
- CBS Sports: "Kawhi Leonard trade on hold: What's next as Raptors, Clippers await results of NBA investigation"
- ESPN: "Clippers-Raptors trade involving Kawhi Leonard on hold amid probe"
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- The outside law firm hired by the NBA has completed its fact-finding work on the Kawhi Leonard/Clippers investigation [Yahoo Sports, reporting The Athletic's Mike Vorkunov]
- The investigation centers on whether Clippers funneled money to Leonard through a $28M endorsement with now-bankrupt Aspiration [multiple sources]
- Aspiration also had a $300M, 23-year arena naming rights deal with the Clippers and Ballmer made a $60M personal investment [CBS Sports]
- The agreed trade: Brandon Ingram + Gradey Dick + 2031/2033 unprotected firsts + 2027 swap + 2 seconds to LAC; Kawhi to Toronto [ESPN]
- League must now determine if Leonard, Clippers, or Ballmer face discipline [CBS Sports]
- Discipline types: suspension, fine, or loss of picks could force renegotiation [CBS Sports]
**Freshness justification:** The Athletic's Vorkunov reported the law firm finished work on July 27; critical development for Raptors trade timeline.

stories.title: DeMar DeRozan Returns to Chicago — Signs with Bulls Despite Warriors' Pitch

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Draymond Green personally called DeMar DeRozan. Pitched him on joining the Warriors.

DeRozan said no.

He's going back to Chicago instead.

18.4 PPG on ~50% shooting last season. The Bulls just landed a walking bucket.

#BullsNation #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
The Warriors offered DeRozan a ring.

DeRozan chose the Bulls.

Golden State struck out on LeBron AND DeRozan in the same offseason.

Sometimes the biggest moves are the ones that don't happen.

#NBA #FreeAgency
